vetSays.line: A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Better close to the fire today.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
🍲 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is eating by the fire — not talking, just eating.
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with 7L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 20s, with calloused knuckles telling A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
🛡️ Eduardo, Kyle, Zakaria and Theo met them at the door — 4 put down. Eduardo, Kyle, Theo are hurt.
🛡️ Eduardo, Sergio, Kyle and Zakaria met them at the door — 4 put down. Eduardo, Sergio, Kyle, Zakaria are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Sergio, Sam and Amina met them at the door — 3 put down. Sergio, Sam, Amina are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Eduardo just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sergio, Kyle and Zakaria met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Sergio, Kyle are hurt.
🛡️ Kyle, Theo, Vasyl and Mara met them at the door — 4 put down. Kyle, Theo, Vasyl, Mara are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Theo just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sergio just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kyle just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sam just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sergio, Kyle, Sam, Vasyl and Amina met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Sergio, Kyle, Sam, Amina are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Paulo just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kirimi just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

Mara: "Vasyl and Kirimi blooded the fourth draft's beasts — we all saw it on the cameras. But only 4 of us carry a weapon, and the fifth draft waits until 6 of us do. We need more hands armed, not more speeches."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
